title: Illustration / Characters / Introduction
slide_intent: Use simple parts to create distinct personalities because a consistent construction system still needs human variety.
strategic_value: A shared drawing method can make different Duolingo characters recognizable as members of one cast.
demonstration: Two differently styled characters accompany the introductory text on purple.
practical_value: Evaluate both construction consistency and individual character when expanding a cast.
